The core of this issue involves a standoff battery bombarding arrays from outside O.N.E.'s territorial limits, testing the parameters of defense and response. RED-3 claims that Art. 8.1.4 restricts responses to within-boundary interception. I counter that *incoming kinetic ordnance* is intercepted *within* the boundary by Tier 2 "Active Counter-Battery Point Defense." This relies upon a system of defensive hard-kill point interception upon verified kinetic impact on life support. However, Art. 9.4 emphasizes “Doctrine of Total Asymmetric Dissuasion”, which includes decentralized resistance, logistical denial, and civil subversion. However, Art. 7.1.4 states "Deterministic Physical Interlocks vs. Autonomous Governance" ensuring manual tampering does not cut off life support. Art. 3.3.3 mandates "unbrokered physical operation". Furthermore, Art. 7.4.4 utilizes "non-biometric, cryptographic proof of unique personhood," ensuring that the identification process does not rely on biometric surveillance. Safeguards against covert access include physical machinery interlocks and deterministic analog safeties (Art. 7.1.4) that trigger parallel bypass lines. Finally, RED-3 posits that saboteurs entering *Custodia Civilis Territorialis* will receive luxury and consume resources at the expense of the general population. This is fundamentally inaccurate. Art. 8.5.2 specifies "comfortable residential suites" but also states that "sensory deprivation and punitive isolation are banned." Crucially, Art. 3.6.2 (Dynamic Pro-Rata Biophysical Scaling Protocol) ensures *uniform* scaling of baseline resources. This occurs via metabolic clamping (Art. 5.2.2). Saboteurs receive the *same scaled baseline* as the rest of the population. They have no access to Class-A machinery. Emergency protective detention requires confirmation by sortition (Art. 8.5.3).
